Switch Toolbox actor-viewer integration
======================================

Source project: https://github.com/KillzXGaming/Switch-Toolbox
License for Toolbox code: GNU GPL version 3 (LICENSE.txt).

Imported from the user-selected Toolbox source snapshot. That snapshot does
not contain Git metadata, so no upstream commit identifier is asserted.
PhysicsTool does not load or invoke an installed copy of Toolbox.

Resources/VisualModel/ToolboxDefaultTexture.png is copied from
Switch_Toolbox_Library/Resources/DefaultTexture.png in that same snapshot.
It is the gray UV-test fallback with colored crosses and is embedded for portability.

GX2.cs, GX2TexRegisters.cs and TEX_FORMAT.cs retain Toolbox's GX2 texture
decoding code. TextureHelper.cs and Utils.cs provide the small helper subset
required by that decoder. Viewer, scene binding, resource resolution and
animation adapters live in PhysicsTool/Formats/Actors and are PhysicsTool code.

The Syroot.*.dll assemblies are the readers distributed in Toolbox/Lib.
The tegra_swizzle_x64.dll binary is the one distributed in Toolbox/Toolbox.

Reader source projects:
https://gitlab.com/Syroot/BinaryData
https://gitlab.com/Syroot/Maths
https://gitlab.com/Syroot/NintenTools.Bfres
https://github.com/KillzXGaming/LegacySwitchLibraries

Tegra texture decoder source:
https://github.com/ScanMountGoat/tegra_swizzle

DirectXTexNet 1.0.7 is restored from NuGet, rather than using Toolbox's older
.NET Framework wrapper. Its license is DirectXTexNet-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/deng0/DirectXTexNet

No game models, textures, animations, executable files or actor packs are
included in these dependencies or in PhysicsTool's distribution.
